item: Row 368: a diagnostics volume set's checks read only regular files, never past the size listed
summary: verify_volume_set hashed each volume with a plain open read to its end after a size check by name, and load_manifest read the sidecar with read_text, so a FIFO at volumes.json in the app's own diagnostics folder blocked every listing for ever; both now read through the backup checks' reader (open_regular + bounded_hash.sha256_read): a link, a pipe or a device is refused unread (the sidecar as a VolumeError, a volume as bad), a volume is read at most one byte past the size its entry lists, an entry with no whole-number size or a name that is not one plain file name is bad and never read, and the sidecar is read at most MANIFEST_MAX_BYTES (64 MiB); a whole set verifies as before.
